pr.body:
## Scope / 范围
Fix the two independently confirmed defects from [TEST-ONLY PR #36](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/pull/36), against the exact PR #24 base `d411f4e17a0ab8e75412e5c91a91ccba6abbbc0e`.

- **P2-EXPORT-01**: Supplier report controls and the first export must not manufacture unsaved changes and block a committed RFQ.
- **P3-NAV-01**: Navigation, supplier-view mode, and selecting a supplier must not warn that a clean RFQ has unsaved changes.
- **Safety invariant**: Real business changes, invalid intermediate inputs, autosave failures and stale versions remain protected. Saved supplier reports still read validated SQLite snapshots.

## Implementation / 实现
- Replace global capture-phase `click`/`input` `dirty=true` heuristic with a deferred post-event comparison of the real persisted workspace state (not transient UI state).
- Recheck actual unsaved business state at New RFQ and committed-report export boundaries.
- Add regression tests 45/46 in real Chromium + isolated SQLite: supplier first ZIP with PDFs, read-only navigation/no false warning, genuinely dirty edit must block reports and warn before discarding it.

## Validation gate / 测试门槛
This is **development code**, not a Codex test-only PR. GitHub Actions CI must complete successfully for the exact final HEAD before handoff to Codex Cloud for independent real-browser acceptance. A new branch/commit alone does not establish PASS.

Keep PR #24 Draft, leave `main` untouched. Do not merge this fix before its CI and independent UAT pass.
pr.title: fix(srm): prevent phantom dirty on supplier export and view navigation (P2/P3)
pr.head: fix/20261020-p2-export-p3-nav-dirty

comments.body:
## ChatGPT development validation complete / 开发者自动化验收完成

**Exact product SHA / 唯一候选:** `9633c03948b1763f99dfa8c2f2f5edc5aa87ba70` (PR #38 HEAD). This is the development fix for two confirmed issues from [PR #36](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/pull/36), not independent Codex acceptance.

### CI gates — PASS on exact SHA
- [SRM UI V2 Unified Candidate Acceptance — run 39389547065](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/actions/runs/39389547065): **SUCCESS**, Windows business safety and Linux Chromium; **46/46** Chromium tests passed.
- [SRM S3/S4 Regression — run 39389547071](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/actions/runs/39389547071): **SUCCESS**, Windows S4/supplier ZIP and Linux Chromium; **46/46** Chromium tests passed.
- Independent new regression scenarios 45 (P2 first supplier report/package, report-picker controls) and 46 (P3 read-only supplier navigation vs genuinely edited allocation) **both PASS**. Existing S4 warning test 44 was strengthened to create an actual unsaved business edit, rather than rely on a spurious navigation dirty flag.
- Artifact storage quota warning remains; evidence/upload failure does not override or replace the business test status.

### Fix scope / 修复范围
Global click/input/change handlers now reconcile persisted business-state signatures instead of marking all view interactions dirty. New RFQ/report guards recheck actual unsaved state, and disabled S4 backup shows adjacent passive reason without auto-scrolling. SQLite schema, price/award rules, quote history and archive content were not changed.

### Gate and handoff / 后续
**DEVELOPMENT-CI-PASS, INDEPENDENT-UAT-PENDING.** Maintain PR #38 and PR #24 as Draft; do not merge to PR #24 or main until Codex Cloud independently reproduces and passes both original business paths plus true-unsaved, S4, save, and supplier-package safety checks. Codex is TEST-ONLY: no product, existing tests, workflow, branch, or merge mutations. Save bilingual reports and real screenshots/download/file checks to its own Draft evidence PR.
